# Getting help

- [Recorded demo](../README.md#try-the-recorded-demo): open the bundled replay.
- [Run an evaluation](../README.md#run-your-own-evaluation): configure a model and run your first episode.
- [Troubleshooting](../docs/guides/TROUBLESHOOTING.md): installation, model setup, rendering and recovery.
- [Documentation](../docs/README.md): task data, scoring and paper reproduction.

For a reproducible problem, [open an issue](https://github.com/xpeng-robotics/VIGIL/issues/new/choose).
Include the command, expected and actual behavior, operating system and Python
version. Keep credentials and model configuration files private.
